Vision, mission & values

Guided by our motto, “Learning for service”.

👁️

Our vision

To be a leading provincial centre of excellence in STEM education, producing learners who serve their communities and the nation.

🎯

Our mission

To provide quality, practical and inclusive science, technology, engineering and mathematics education that prepares every learner for further study, work and service.

🤝 Service

Using knowledge for the good of others.

🏆 Excellence

Striving for the best in every subject.

⚖️ Integrity

Honesty and responsibility in all we do.

💡 Innovation

Curiosity, creativity and problem-solving.

🧭 Discipline

Respect, order and hard work.

Levels & curriculum

We teach the OBC syllabus in Grades 10–12 and the competence-based curriculum (CBC) in Forms 1–4. Pick a level to see its subjects.

Admissions

Co-educational boarding school. A-level enrolment starts next year. Typical process; please confirm current requirements with the school office.

  1. Contact the school
    Call the office or email us to ask about available places.
  2. Apply
    Complete the application or placement form.
  3. Submit documents
    Previous school report or results, copy of birth certificate or NRC, passport photos.
  4. Confirmation
    The school confirms your placement and boarding.
  5. Report to school
    Arrive on opening day with the required items.
📞 Call the head teacher✉️ Email admissions
